description: This PHP class 'BuzzEmbeddedURL' encapsulates a URL related to a video and provides functionality to generate an embedded URL for known video platforms (YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion) by inspecting the original URL. It includes methods to validate the URL and cache the embedded URL once generated.

classes.name: BuzzEmbeddedURL
classes.description: Represents a video URL and provides methods to generate and validate embedded URLs for various video platforms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a video URL.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Attempts to generate an embedded URL by checking known video platforms if it hasn't been generated/cached already.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Checks whether the embedded URL can be successfully generated and is valid.
